caption: The drawing depicts a wooden hutch with a warm brown color and visible wood grain texture. The upper section consists of two vertical cabinet doors, each featuring four rectangular glass panes arranged in a two-by-two grid; behind the glass, faint blue and white curtain-like shapes are visible. Below the glass-paneled section, there are four rectangular panels arranged horizontally. The lower portion of the hutch forms a table supported by four turned wooden legs, with the front two being more ornate and the back two plainer. Beneath the tabletop, there is a single wide drawer with a round metallic knob on each end. The background of the drawing is a light beige color, and the artist’s signature, "Harry King K.C. MO," appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Walnut Desk and Bookcase
